item.text: Both approved posts are running. The first day spent $57.38 for 20 link clicks; the relay-focused post is delivering more clicks and a lower cost per click so far. I’ll let the comparison gather more data before shifting budget.

Through October 25, spend is $213.73 with 76 link clicks. I’ve shifted more budget to the relay-focused post, which costs about $2.61 per click versus $3.25 for the deadline post. The combined lifetime caps remain $700.

Five days in, the campaign has spent $371.47 and generated 133 link clicks. The relay-focused post continues to produce cheaper clicks, so it now has $525 of the total allocation; the deadline post retains $175 as Halloween approaches. These are traffic results—trial starts remain unmeasured by X.

With two days left, spend is $529.89 and link clicks total 205. Delivery is on pace for the $700 ceiling, and the relay-focused post remains the stronger source of clicks. I’m keeping the current allocation and checking the final-day pacing.
